name: ringkas
description: Daily & weekly notes of your Claude Code sessions, summarized by free Gemini (or local Ollama). Zero Claude tokens, privacy filters built in.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Free key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored in your system's secure credential store. Leave empty if you use GEMINI_API_KEY or a local model (config.json).

day_ends_at.title: Day ends at (HH:MM)
day_ends_at.description: When your day ends. 23:30 = late-night work goes to the next day's note. A morning time like 02:00 ends the day the next morning (night owls). 00:00 = plain calendar day.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: auto = follow the system (DST included), or a name like Asia/Jakarta, Europe/Berlin, America/New_York.

weekly_day.title: Weekly rollup day
weekly_day.description: Day the past week's notes are merged into one weekly note: monday … sunday.

language.title: Summary language
language.description: auto = the language you used most in the conversation, or a language such as en, id, es.
